verdict.rationale: Mastra itself is a code-first TypeScript framework (CLI commands, `createTool`, `createWorkflow` APIs) rather than a product with a native natural-language command interface, but it does expose an MCP docs server so AI-native coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf) can interact with and build Mastra apps via natural language, and agents built with Mastra inherently reason over NL user input to select tools/actions. missing for 10: no evidence of a natural-language CLI/chat interface for operating Mastra's own tooling (deploy, configure, manage workflows) — only MCP-mediated doc access and agent-level NL reasoning are documented.
